description: Convert a number into written English words. Set currency to true to write it as UK pounds and pence (cheque style, ending 'only'). Supports up to 999,999,999,999 with decimals to two places. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/number-to-words/

currency.description: Write as UK pounds and pence (default false)

value.description: The number to spell out, e.g. '1234.5' or '19.99'. May include commas.

name: hopi_number_to_words

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)

title: Number to words converter
